name: ULTRA1500
description: The ULTRA1500 is Hooga's full-body quad-chip red light therapy panel — Hooga's most feature-complete panel, sized to cover an adult from head to hip in a single position. It delivers four wavelengths from every LED — 630 nm, 660 nm, 810 nm, and 850 nm — through 300 × 5W quad-chip LEDs , producing an irradiance of 165 mW/cm² at 6 inches . At 1500W with a 39.5" × 8.6" footprint, the ULTRA1500 is designed for full-body sessions with the most advanced feature set Hooga offers. It ships with a door mount, hanging kit with adjustable pulley , and connects to Hooga mobile stands (sold separately). Why Quad-Chip LEDs Matter Most red light panels use single- or dual-chip LEDs, meaning each LED emits one or two wavelengths. The ULTRA1500's quad-chip LEDs pack four chips into every single LED — one for each of the 630, 660, 810, and 850 nm wavelengths. Every point on the panel emits the full spectrum, giving you a more even and consistent light output across the entire treatment area. Full Control at Your Fingertips The ULTRA1500 features an interactive digital touchscreen with slider controls for precision adjustments. You get brightness control from 1% to 100% for red and near-infrared wavelengths independently, an adjustable timer from 1 to 30 minutes , and pulse frequency control from 1Hz to 9999Hz . Modular and Stand-Compatible The ULTRA1500 can connect physically to other ULTRA panels ( ULTRA750 ) on a Hooga mobile stand to build even larger treatment areas. It also syncs wirelessly with other ULTRA panels via the included remote control. Who the ULTRA1500 Is For The ULTRA1500 is Hooga's most feature-complete full-body panel — a good fit for wellness enthusiasts, biohackers, and anyone who wants four wavelengths, granular controls, and full-body coverage in one device. For a smaller, more portable option in the same ULTRA line, see the ULTRA750 or ULTRA360 .
